query: SELECT c.id FROM privacy.contact c WHERE c.oldest_key_version < $1 OR (c.phone IS NOT NULL AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM privacy.contact_index i WHERE i.contact_id = c.id AND i.purpose = $4 AND i.key_version <> ALL($2::int4[])) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest($2::int4[]) AS k(v) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM privacy.contact_index i WHERE i.contact_id = c.id AND i.purpose = $4 AND i.key_version = k.v)))) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT $3
